title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 6,051–6,100 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

words.definition: 國際精品咖啡協會 (SCA 80 分以上) 的；專長

examples.en: Specialty coffee celebrates distinct micro-climates, traceable farms, and meticulous harvesting standards.
examples.zh: 精品咖啡，彰顯獨特微型氣候、可溯源莊園與極致人工採摘標準。

examples.en: To earn a specialty coffee rating, beans must score at least 80 points during certified blind cupping.
examples.zh: 想要榮獲精品咖啡法定評等，生豆在國際證照杯測師盲測評鑑中必須斬獲至少八十分以上的高分。

examples.en: Independent specialty roasters build direct trade relationships with smallholder coffee farmers.
examples.zh: 獨立精品咖啡烘豆商透過直接貿易模式深入偏鄉，直接向原產地咖啡小農採購第一手優質生豆。

words.definition: 產區微氣候火山土壤風土條件 (Terroir)

examples.en: High-elevation volcanic terroir infuses Alishan coffee with distinct sweet tea and floral aromatics.
examples.zh: 阿里山高海拔火山土壤風土條件，賦予咖啡豆獨特的高山茶香與優雅花香氣息。

examples.en: The unique terroir of the Ethiopian highlands produces beans renowned for bright citrus acidity.
examples.zh: 衣索比亞高原得天獨厚的原始風土環境，孕育出以活潑明亮柑橘果酸質聞名於世的傳世名豆。

examples.en: Soil mineral composition, rainfall patterns, and sun exposure combine to shape the coffee's distinctive terroir.
examples.zh: 土壤礦物質含量、日照坡向與年均降雨量相互交織，共同雕琢出每座咖啡莊園獨一無二的風土風貌。

words.definition: 藝伎 (Geisha) 與鐵比卡原生阿拉比卡品種

examples.en: The prized Panama Geisha cultivar yields an extraordinary explosion of jasmine blossom and bergamot notes.
examples.zh: 身價不凡的巴拿馬藝伎阿拉比卡品種，在杯中爆發出驚豔的茉莉花與佛手柑香氣。

examples.en: Farmers grafted the traditional Typica cultivar onto disease-resistant rootstocks to battle leaf rust.
examples.zh: 高山莊園農民將古老的傳統鐵比卡原生品種嫁接於抗病砧木上，以抵抗葉鏽病菌的侵襲。

examples.en: Discovering an ancient heirloom cultivar deep in the mountain forest thrilled the botanical expedition.
examples.zh: 在偏遠原始森林深處採集到一株罕見的衣索比亞傳家寶原生樹種，讓植物學家與尋豆師雀躍萬分。

words.definition: 兩千公尺高海拔高密度極硬豆 (SHB)

examples.en: Cool night temperatures at high altitude slow bean ripening, concentrating complex organic sugars.
examples.zh: 高海拔涼爽的夜間低溫減緩咖啡果實成熟，使內部凝聚出極其豐富的天然糖分。

examples.en: Coffee cultivated at an altitude exceeding 1,800 meters develops high structural density and lively acidity.
examples.zh: 在海拔超過一千八百公尺高山種植的咖啡豆，內部質地極端緊密堅硬且展現活潑純淨的果酸。

examples.en: Extreme mountain altitude requires pickers to navigate steep, fog-shrouded volcanic ridges daily.
examples.zh: 險峻的高山海拔地形，迫使採豆工每天必須腰繫竹簍穿梭在雲霧繚繞的陡峭火山稜線間採摘。

words.definition: 單一小農莊園客製化微批次精品豆

examples.en: Roasters bid eagerly for exclusive micro-lot coffees harvested from a single sunny mountainside plot.
examples.zh: 烘豆師競相出價搶標來自單一陽光斜坡梯田、限量生產的頂級客製化微批次豆。

examples.en: The producer separated this experimental micro-lot to showcase a novel natural yeast fermentation technique.
examples.zh: 莊園莊主特地將這批僅有數袋的實驗性微批次豆獨立處理，以展現創新的野生酵母發酵工藝。

examples.en: Packaging each micro-lot with complete farmer portraits and picking dates honors agricultural transparency.
examples.zh: 在每一包微批次咖啡豆外袋上完整標註農民肖像與精確採收日期，彰顯了產地溯源的最高透明度。

words.definition: 人工手採全紅成熟咖啡鮮果；櫻桃

examples.en: Pickers select only deep burgundy red coffee cherries at peak sugar brix levels across steep slopes.
examples.zh: 採豆工在陡峭斜坡上，手眼並用僅採摘糖度達標、色澤如紅寶石般熟透的咖啡鮮果。

examples.en: Green, unripe coffee cherries must be sorted out immediately to avoid astringent woody defects in the cup.
examples.zh: 未成熟的青綠咖啡漿果必須在第一時間挑除剔除，以杜絕杯中出現令人不悅的生澀木質雜味。

examples.en: Floating fresh coffee cherries in deep water tanks separates hollow floaters from dense, ripe fruit.
examples.zh: 將剛採下的新鮮咖啡鮮果倒入深水水槽中進行浮水篩選，能輕易將乾癟漂浮果與沉底飽滿熟果分開。

words.definition: 咖啡生豆採收後後製處理法工藝

examples.en: Experimental post-harvest coffee processing unlocks previously unimaginable fruit flavors in green beans.
examples.zh: 前衛大膽的採收後後製處理法，為綠色咖啡生豆解鎖前所未見的熱帶水果狂想。

examples.en: Careful moisture management throughout processing prevents unwanted fungal mold growth during storage.
examples.zh: 後製處理全程嚴密掌控生豆水分活度與含水率，能徹底防範倉儲期間滋生肉眼難見的赭麴黴菌。

examples.en: The farm invested in high-tech stainless steel equipment to refine its proprietary washed processing protocol.
examples.zh: 這座先驅莊園斥重金引進食品級不鏽鋼後製設備，傾力研發專屬的水洗發酵工藝配方。

words.definition: 經典水洗發酵去果膠處理法 (乾淨明亮) 的

examples.en: Fully washed processing strips fruit pulp cleanly, highlighting pristine floral acidity and tea-like transparency.
examples.zh: 水洗處理法完全洗淨果膠層，完美凸顯出純淨晶瑩的花香酸質與高山茶感。

examples.en: Connoisseurs prize washed coffees for their clean mouthfeel and unmasked terroir expression.
examples.zh: 精品咖啡老饕最鍾愛道地的經典水洗豆，只因其口感極致乾淨純粹、毫無保留展現土地原生風味。

examples.en: After mechanical pulping, the washed beans ferment in freshwater channels for thirty-six hours.
examples.zh: 機械去除外果皮後，水洗生豆在流動的山泉水渠道中進行三十六小時低溫發酵去果膠。

words.definition: 經典非洲棚架日曬處理法 (濃郁熟果甜感) 的

examples.en: Sun-dried natural coffees ferment slowly inside intact fruit skins, developing heavy blueberry and winey sweetness.
examples.zh: 日曬處理法讓咖啡豆在果皮內慢速日曬發酵，醞釀出濃郁的藍莓果醬與紅酒甜感。

examples.en: Workers turn the natural coffee cherries constantly on raised African beds to prevent over-fermentation.
examples.zh: 莊園工人在通風非洲高架棚架上每隔半小時翻動一次日曬鮮果，確保均勻乾燥並防止發酵過度走味。

examples.en: The thick sweetness and tropical punch of a natural processed bean makes it a favorite for espresso blends.
examples.zh: 日曬處理生豆濃厚的甜感與熱帶水果炸彈風味，使其成為頂級義式配方豆爭相採用的靈魂基底。

words.definition: 蜜處理法 (保留部分果膠層黏膜甜度)；蜂蜜

examples.en: Yellow and black honey processing leaves varying amounts of sweet fruit mucilage on parchment during drying.
examples.zh: 蜜處理法，在日曬乾燥時保留不同比例的黏稠果膠層，賦予咖啡飽滿蜜糖甜度。

examples.en: Black honey coffees undergo prolonged shade drying to maximize complex sweetness and heavy body.
examples.zh: 黑蜜處理咖啡豆在遮陰網下經歷更緩慢的低溫乾燥，將深層複雜的焦糖甜感與醇厚油脂感發揮至極致。

examples.en: The sticky sugary coating on honey processed parchment requires frequent turning under open skies.
examples.zh: 附著在蜜處理內果皮外層黏稠如果醬的果膠糖分，在陽光下曝曬時需要工人極具耐心地頻繁翻拌。

words.definition: 厭氧密封發酵與二氧化碳浸漬發酵的

examples.en: Anaerobic fermentation in oxygen-free stainless steel tanks yields intense cinnamon and bubblegum aromatics.
examples.zh: 在無氧不銹鋼密封發酵槽中進行厭氧發酵，創造出肉桂辛香與泡泡糖的迷人風味。

examples.en: Purging oxygen with carbon dioxide creates an anaerobic environment favored by specialized lactic bacteria.
examples.zh: 在密封發酵桶中灌入二氧化碳排擠氧氣營造純厭氧環境，引導乳酸菌群進行特化發酵代換。

examples.en: Judges at the barista championship were blown away by the wild tropical notes of this anaerobic lot.
examples.zh: 世界咖啡師大賽評審團，被這款雙重厭氧處理微批次豆所散發出的狂野百香果熱帶香氣深深震撼。

words.definition: 精密菌種接種與低溫受控發酵工序

examples.en: Inoculating natural fruit yeast into the fermentation tank controls acidity levels with scientific precision.
examples.zh: 在發酵槽中接種特選天然水果酵母，能以科學精準度掌控酸值曲線演化。

examples.en: Extended cold fermentation unlocks delicate wine-like nuances without producing pungent vinegar notes.
examples.zh: 採用低溫延長發酵工藝，能為咖啡豆引出如勃艮第紅酒般的優雅香氣，且絕不產生刺鼻醋酸敗筆。

examples.en: The master processor measures pH and Brix levels hourly throughout the critical fermentation window.
examples.zh: 專業後製處理大師在發酵關鍵數十小時內，每小時以精密探針量測發酵液的 pH 酸鹼值與糖度變化。

words.definition: 半熱風鑄鐵雙層滾筒數位烘豆機；烘豆師

examples.en: The master roaster monitors exhaust gas sensors and drum temperatures inside the cast-iron roaster.
examples.zh: 烘豆大師在鑄鐵雙層滾筒烘豆機旁，緊盯排氣熱風溫度與鍋爐轉速。

examples.en: Heavy double-walled steel drums inside the roaster ensure radiant, even heat transfer to every bean.
examples.zh: 烘豆機內部厚實的雙層不鏽鋼滾筒，確保柔和穩定的熱傳導與輻射熱均勻包裹每一顆旋轉中的生豆。

examples.en: After dropping the hot roast into the cooling tray, high-power fans cool the beans down in sixty seconds.
examples.zh: 一鍵出鍋落入下層冷卻盤後，大功率抽風馬達在六十秒內迅速將滾燙熟豆抽風冷卻定格風味。

words.definition: 數位曲線精準烘焙工藝 (RoR 升溫速率調控)

examples.en: Light profile roasting preserves delicate floral aroma precursors without introducing smoky charred tastes.
examples.zh: 精準的淺度曲線烘焙，完整保留生豆纖細的花果芳香物質且完全無焦苦煙燻雜味。

examples.en: Advanced software plots real-time roasting curves, helping artisans replicate award-winning profiles consistently.
examples.zh: 先進數位烘豆軟體即時繪製升溫曲線，協助烘豆名師在每批烘焙中分秒不差重現冠軍烘焙曲線。

examples.en: Roasting transforms raw, grassy green seeds into aromatic, brittle brown beans brimming with volatile oils.
examples.zh: 烘焙工藝將青澀生硬的咖啡生豆，化腐朽為神奇蛻變為散發誘人芳香、飽含芳香揮發油的熟成咖啡豆。

words.definition: 烘焙升溫速率曲線 (Rate of Rise RoR)；上升

examples.en: Managing a steadily declining rate of rise (RoR) avoids baking the beans and ensures lively cup acidity.
examples.zh: 精準掌控平穩下降的升溫速率曲線，能避免把豆子烤平並鎖住活潑明亮果酸。

examples.en: A sudden spike in the rate of rise near first crack can scorch bean exteriors, causing harsh bitterness.
examples.zh: 一爆前後升溫速率曲線若發生突發反彈飆升，會直接燙傷豆表並產生令人難受的焦苦雜味。

examples.en: Experienced roasters read subtle changes in RoR to anticipate thermal momentum shifts inside the drum.
examples.zh: 經驗老到的烘豆師敏銳洞察 RoR 升溫斜率的微小起伏，提前調整瓦斯風門以掌控鍋爐熱動能。

words.definition: 烘焙一爆密集聲 (First Crack 芳香爆發)；裂紋

examples.en: The sudden burst of first crack signals that internal moisture steam is fracturing the bean's cellular walls.
examples.zh: 烘豆鍋爐內傳來劈啪清脆的第一爆，宣告內部水蒸氣撐破細胞壁釋放迷人芳香。

examples.en: The roaster reduced burner power right at the start of first crack to extend the caramel development phase.
examples.zh: 烘豆師在一爆初響的黃金瞬間精準關小瓦斯火力，以平穩延長焦糖化反應的風味發展期。

examples.en: Listening for the distinct pops of first crack guides decisions on when to drop light-roast specialty lots.
examples.zh: 屏氣凝神聆聽第一爆密集爆鳴聲的起伏節奏，是決定淺焙精品豆何時出鍋下豆的最關鍵聲學指引。

words.definition: 剛烘好熟豆單向排氣閥養豆排碳工序

examples.en: Allowing a seven-day degassing period lets excess carbon dioxide escape, opening up complex floral flavors.
examples.zh: 烘焙完成後靜置七天進行養豆排碳，排出多餘二氧化碳，讓豐富花果香氣完全綻放。

examples.en: Freshly roasted beans trapped without proper degassing will create turbulent, sour espresso extractions.
examples.zh: 剛出爐未經適度排碳熟成的咖啡豆直接沖煮，大量二氧化碳氣體會干擾水流萃取造成尖銳死酸。

examples.en: Modern coffee pouches feature a one-way valve that facilitates degassing while blocking incoming ambient oxygen.
examples.zh: 專業咖啡密封包裝袋上必備單向排氣閥，能讓熟豆自然排出二氧化碳並徹底阻絕外部氧氣入侵。

words.definition: 64mm 特殊鍍鈦合金平刀磨豆機刀盤

examples.en: Precision-machined titanium flat burrs produce uniform coffee grounds with minimal fines for clean extraction.
examples.zh: 高精密 CNC 切削的鍍鈦合金平刀刀盤，能研磨出粒徑均勻、極少細粉的純淨咖啡粉。

examples.en: Upgrading to SSP specialty burrs transformed his pour-over clarity by creating unimodal particle spreads.
examples.zh: 為磨豆機升級直徑 64mm 專用鍍鈦平刀刀盤，產生單峰粒徑分佈，讓手沖咖啡的風味層次晶瑩透亮。

examples.en: Conical burrs turn at slower speeds, generating less friction heat to protect fragile volatile aromatics.
examples.zh: 錐形刀盤以較低轉速進行研磨，有效抑制研磨摩擦生熱，守護咖啡熟豆中珍貴纖細的揮發性芳香油。

words.definition: 零殘粉單劑量高均勻度電動磨豆機

examples.en: The low-RPM single-dose coffee grinder retains virtually zero leftover grinds between different beans.
examples.zh: 低轉速單劑量電動磨豆機，在更換不同莊園咖啡豆時能做到近乎零殘粉滯留。

examples.en: Cleaning your electric grinder with compressed air prevents stale coffee oils from tainting morning cups.
examples.zh: 定期使用專用吹塵球清潔電動磨豆機殘粉通道，能徹底杜絕氧化油耗味污染每一杯新鮮清晨咖啡。

examples.en: Hand grinders with premium stainless steel bearings allow backpackers to brew fresh coffee on peaks.
examples.zh: 搭載頂級雙不鏽鋼軸承的高精度手搖磨豆機，讓山友在百岳稜線上也能隨時現磨現煮頂級精品咖啡。

words.definition: 研磨顆粒粒徑極致均勻度 (超低細粉率)

examples.en: Grind size uniformity prevents bitter over-extraction from micro-fines clogging the paper filter.
examples.zh: 研磨顆粒極致的粒徑均勻度，能防止微細粉堵塞濾紙而造成苦澀過萃。

examples.en: Sifting ground coffee through micro-sieves benchmarks particle size uniformity across different equipment.
examples.zh: 將研磨咖啡粉倒入微米篩粉器中進行粒徑篩分，能客觀評定不同磨豆刀盤的顆粒均勻度水準。

examples.en: High uniformity ensures that hot water extracts every coffee grind at identical, predictable rates.
examples.zh: 卓越的顆粒粒徑均勻度，能確保沖煮熱水以完全均等、一致且可預測的速率萃取每顆咖啡顆粒。

words.definition: V60 螺旋肋骨錐形手沖咖啡濾杯；手沖

examples.en: The conical V60 pourover dripper features sixty-degree spiral ribs that guide water smoothly through the bed.
examples.zh: 經典六十度錐形 V60 手沖濾杯，透過內部螺旋肋骨引導熱水流暢穿透咖啡粉層。

examples.en: Brewing a delicate Ethiopian coffee via pourover highlights floral jasmine perfume and peach nectar sweetness.
examples.zh: 採用手沖濾杯精心沖煮一杯衣索比亞精品豆，能完美釋放出茉莉花香與白桃果汁般的清甜。

examples.en: Folding the bonded paper filter tightly against the pourover cone eliminates bypass around the sides.
examples.zh: 將無漂白原木濾紙折線緊密貼合於錐形手沖濾杯內壁，能徹底消除邊緣未經萃取的旁路水流。

words.definition: 細口鵝頸精準電子溫控手沖壺；水壺

examples.en: The electric gooseneck kettle heats mountain spring water to exactly ninety-two degrees Celsius.
examples.zh: 搭載細嘴長頸的溫控手沖壺，能將甘甜山泉水精準加熱至攝氏九十二度。

examples.en: The curved spout of the kettle allows the barista to pour water at a ninety-degree perpendicular angle.
examples.zh: 手沖壺流線優雅的鵝頸細嘴造型，讓咖啡師在注水時能維持近乎垂直九十度的精準落水點。

examples.en: Integrated digital temperature displays on modern kettles maintain holding temperatures within one degree.
examples.zh: 現代電子手沖壺底座內建的數位 PID 溫控面板，能將壺內水溫恆溫鎖定在正負一度的極窄誤差內。

words.definition: 每秒三克穩定垂直細緻注水水流流速；流動

examples.en: Maintaining a gentle, vertical water flow rate prevents splashing and channels through the coffee bed.
examples.zh: 穩定維持每秒約三克垂直細緻注水水流，能溫柔濕潤粉層且完全不濺起水花。

examples.en: Controlling your flow rate allows you to extend contact time for denser, high-altitude beans.
examples.zh: 精準控制手腕的注水流速節奏，能有效延長熱水與高密度極硬高山豆的浸泡萃取接觸時間。

examples.en: A shaky pouring hand disrupts the laminar water flow, resulting in uneven saturation of the grinds.
examples.zh: 握持手壺懸空發抖會破壞平穩的層流水柱，進而造成濾杯內部咖啡粉層乾濕飽和不均的遺憾。

words.definition: 溫柔畫圈注水產生之均勻水流擾動；亂流

examples.en: Gentle circular pouring introduces controlled turbulence, ensuring every coffee particle extracts evenly.
examples.zh: 緩慢由內向外均勻畫圈注水，製造出恰到好處的水流擾動，讓每顆咖啡粉均勻萃取。

examples.en: Excessive pouring turbulence agitates heavy fines downward, causing the filter paper to choke and stall.
examples.zh: 過度劇烈的衝擊性水流擾動會把微細粉衝向下層，進而堵塞濾紙孔洞導致粉層積水不退。

examples.en: Swirling the brewer during the draw-down phase creates gentle turbulence that flattens the coffee bed.
examples.zh: 在最後水流滴濾階段輕柔晃動搖晃濾杯，能在粉層表面製造微幅擾動並留下一張平坦如鏡的粉床。

words.definition: 手沖前四十秒高溫悶蒸 (排氣膨脹如漢堡)；開花

examples.en: Pouring double the dry weight in hot water initiates the bloom, releasing fragrant gases as the bed expands.
examples.zh: 注入粉重兩倍的熱水啟動悶蒸，新鮮咖啡粉層如蓬鬆漢堡般鼓起並釋放馥郁芳香。

examples.en: Watching the freshly roasted coffee bloom like a rising muffin is one of the greatest joys of brewing.
examples.zh: 靜靜凝視剛磨好的新鮮咖啡粉在熱水浸潤下如馬芬蛋糕般高高隆起膨脹，是手沖過程中最治癒的時刻。

examples.en: A thirty-second bloom allows carbon dioxide to vent so subsequent pours can extract soluble sugars freely.
examples.zh: 長達三十秒的充分悶蒸能讓排斥水分的二氧化碳氣體順利排空，好讓後續水流暢通萃取可溶性果糖。

words.definition: 手沖多段式分段注水萃取動力學；萃取

examples.en: Dialing in the perfect extraction yields a balanced cup bursting with sweet citrus and zero astringency.
examples.zh: 透過精準校正研磨度與水溫掌握最佳萃取率，沖煮出一杯酸甜平衡且毫無澀感的甘醇咖啡。

examples.en: Under-extraction tastes sour and hollow, while over-extraction pulls bitter, dry polyphenols from cellulose.
examples.zh: 萃取不足的咖啡口感尖酸單薄且空洞，而過度萃取則會將植物纖維中乾澀苦口的多元酚類全數榨出。

examples.en: Changing water temperature alters extraction kinetics, selectively drawing different flavor compounds.
examples.zh: 微幅調整沖煮水溫能改變熱水萃取的動力學速率，從而隨心所欲選擇性提取不同的芳香化合物。

words.definition: 咖啡數位光學折射儀 (測量 TDS 濃度)

examples.en: Baristas place a drop of brewed coffee onto the digital refractometer to measure total dissolved solids (TDS).
examples.zh: 咖啡師滴取一滴冷卻咖啡液在數位折射儀鏡片上，精準測量總溶解固體濃度。

examples.en: Calibrating the optical refractometer with distilled water ensures precise scientific measurement.
examples.zh: 每次測量前使用常溫蒸餾水對數位光學校準折射儀歸零，確保科學數據的絕對精準無誤。

examples.en: Recording refractometer readings helps the quality control manager maintain brew consistency across branches.
examples.zh: 詳實記錄折射儀測得的 TDS 濃度數據，協助連鎖精品咖啡品牌在全台各分店維持百分之百的一致品質。

words.definition: 18%–22% SCA 黃金萃取率百分比；產量

examples.en: An optimal twenty percent extraction yield captures sweet fruit sugars while leaving harsh tannins behind.
examples.zh: 達到百分之二十的黃金萃取率，能將果糖甜感完整萃出並把苦澀單寧留在濾紙上。

examples.en: Fine-tuning the grind size lifted the extraction yield into the ideal sweet spot without bitterness.
examples.zh: 微幅調細磨豆機刻度，能將萃取率推升至最甘甜芳香的甜蜜點區間，且完全不帶一絲雜澀。

examples.en: Achieving a consistent extraction yield proves that the barista has mastered steady water pouring mechanics.
examples.zh: 能在連續十杯沖煮中保持恆定一致的萃取率，印證了這位咖啡師已徹底精通穩健的手部注水控水力學。

words.definition: 1:15 黃金粉水比 (15 克粉沖 225 克水)

examples.en: A standard 1:15 coffee-to-water ratio balances rich aromatic intensity with tea-like clarity.
examples.zh: 採用一比十五的黃金粉水比例，在濃郁芳香層次與清亮茶感之間取得極致平衡。

examples.en: Adjusting your brewing ratio to 1:16 lightens the mouthfeel, highlighting fragile jasmine floral notes.
examples.zh: 將沖煮粉水比微調放大至一比十六，能讓整體口感更顯輕盈通透，進一步放大細緻的茉莉花香。

examples.en: Digital brewing scales calculate exact brewing ratios automatically to streamline countertop workflows.
examples.zh: 專業手沖電子秤能依據注入水重即時自動換算粉水比，讓吧台沖煮出杯流程流暢高效。

words.definition: 九巴大氣壓黃金萃取雙份義式濃縮

examples.en: A balanced double espresso extracted under nine bars of pressure delivers intense, syrup-like body.
examples.zh: 在九大氣壓下精準萃取出的雙份義式濃縮，質地濃稠如糖漿且層次極為豐富。

examples.en: Sipping a well-pulled espresso reveals bright acidity seamlessly woven into dark chocolate richness.
examples.zh: 細啜一口黃金萃取的單品濃縮咖啡，能感受到明亮果酸與深邃黑巧克力的醇厚風味交織融合。

examples.en: High water pressure emulsifies insoluble coffee oils into a thick, concentrated twenty-five-milliliter shot.
examples.zh: 強大的九巴水壓將不溶於水的天然咖啡油脂徹底乳化，濃縮凝結為一杯二十五毫升的精華瓊漿。

words.definition: 無底沖煮手把 (直視底部萃取流速)

examples.en: Using a bottomless naked portafilter reveals whether water is channeling unevenly through the puck.
examples.zh: 使用無底手把，能直接肉眼觀察底部水流是否均勻匯聚成一道黃金水柱。

examples.en: The heavy chrome-plated brass portafilter locks tightly into the group head with a clockwise turn.
examples.zh: 沉甸甸的電鍍重黃銅沖煮手把，向順時針方向堅定一旋，穩穩卡入義式咖啡機飽滿的沖煮頭內。

examples.en: Spraying spurts from the bottomless portafilter indicate uneven density distribution inside the grounds.
examples.zh: 使用無底把手萃取時若出現噴濺水柱，代表粉餅內部存在壓實不均或通道效應的嚴重缺陷。

words.definition: 精密雷射微孔奈米塗層濾壓粉碗；籃子

examples.en: The precision 18-gram filter basket features micro-machined holes that promote uniform bottom extraction.
examples.zh: 採用微米雷射雕刻微孔的精密濾壓粉碗，能確保水流在整個粉餅底部均勻通過。

examples.en: Nanotech coatings applied to the stainless steel basket ensure effortless knock-out of spent coffee pucks.
examples.zh: 不銹鋼粉碗表面被覆的先進奈米抗沾塗層，讓敲打手把倒出咖啡渣餅變得俐落乾脆毫不沾黏。

examples.en: Upgrading to a high-extraction ridgeless basket increases total dissolved solids by two percent.
examples.zh: 換裝無內圈凹槽的高流速精密粉碗，能讓義式濃縮咖啡的總溶解固體萃取濃度顯著提升兩個百分點。

words.definition: WDT 超細不銹鋼布粉針 (掃除結塊)；針

examples.en: Stirring the ground coffee with a fine needle distribution tool breaks up clumps for a flat, even bed.
examples.zh: 用超細不銹鋼布粉針輕輕攪拌咖啡粉，能徹底掃除結塊並營造出平整均勻的粉床。

examples.en: The Weiss Distribution Technique (WDT) utilizes surgical needles to homogenize coffee grinds inside the basket.
examples.zh: 享譽全球的 WDT 布粉法，利用細如針灸針的極細不鏽鋼針，將粉碗內的咖啡粉徹底梳理均質化。

examples.en: Whisking with flexible needles eliminates air pockets that would otherwise turn into catastrophic channels.
examples.zh: 用彈性鋼針在粉碗中快速劃圈梳理，能掃除深藏於粉層內部的微小空隙，杜絕致命通道效應。

words.definition: 三十磅定壓恆平壓粉器垂直均勻填壓

examples.en: Applying firm, level tamping with thirty pounds of force compresses the grounds into a uniform puck.
examples.zh: 使用三十磅定壓壓粉器進行水平垂直填壓，將鬆散咖啡粉均勻壓製成緊密平整的粉餅。

examples.en: Auto-leveling calibrated tamping tools guarantee an upright, un-tilted surface every single shot.
examples.zh: 搭載定壓自動水平定位環的智慧壓粉器，保證每次下壓出的粉餅表面皆保持絕對的水平垂直。

examples.en: Uneven tamping forces water toward the lower edge, ruining the balance of the resulting espresso.
examples.zh: 斜偏不平的傾斜填壓會迫使加壓熱水往較薄的一側奔流，徹底摧毀整杯濃縮咖啡的平衡美感。

words.definition: 消除粉餅通道效應 (防止過萃苦澀水感)

examples.en: Poor puck preparation causes water channeling, creating localized over-extracted bitter spots.
examples.zh: 不良的填壓布粉會引發水流走捷徑的通道效應，導致局部過萃苦澀且整體口感稀薄。

examples.en: Observing pinholes on the discarded coffee puck confirms that destructive channeling occurred during the shot.
examples.zh: 仔細觀察敲出的咖啡渣餅表面若佈滿如針孔般的穿孔凹洞，證實萃取時發生了嚴重的通道破壞。

examples.en: Pre-infusion wets the coffee bed under gentle low pressure, effectively minimizing channeling risks.
examples.zh: 啟動低壓預浸泡工序能讓粉餅在低壓下溫柔吸水膨脹，從根本上將高壓通道效應風險降至最低。

words.definition: 義式濃縮表面金黃虎斑狀濃郁油脂泡沫

examples.en: Freshly pulled espresso is crowned with thick, hazelnut-colored crema patterned with delicate tiger stripes.
examples.zh: 剛萃取出的濃縮咖啡頂端覆蓋著一層厚實、呈榛果色且帶有斑斕虎紋的金黃油脂泡沫。

examples.en: The persistent golden crema traps aromatic carbon dioxide bubbles, releasing perfumes with every sip.
examples.zh: 持久厚實的黃金克麗瑪泡沫牢牢鎖住了芳香微氣泡，在每一口啜飲中釋放出濃郁鼻息香氣。

examples.en: A pale, thin crema indicates under-extraction or stale coffee beans roasted months ago.
examples.zh: 稀薄發白且迅速消散的克麗瑪，通常代表萃取不足或使用了幾個月前早已走味氧化的陳年咖啡豆。

words.definition: 蒸氣旋渦打發細緻綿密如絲綢熱奶泡

examples.en: Steaming fresh milk into silky microfoam creates a glossy wet-paint texture ideal for free-pour latte art.
examples.zh: 用高溫蒸氣將鮮奶打發成如絲綢般綿密細緻的微氣泡奶泡，泛著如亮光漆般的迷人光澤。

examples.en: Submerging the steam wand tip slightly below the surface incorporates air into velvety microfoam.
examples.zh: 將蒸氣噴嘴尖端巧妙浸入液面下方數毫米處帶動旋渦進氣，將全脂鮮奶打發成極致絲滑的微氣泡。

examples.en: Large dry bubbles must be tapped and swirled out of the pitcher to leave only uniform, shiny microfoam.
examples.zh: 在桌面上輕敲鋼杯並優雅晃動旋轉，震破粗大乾燥的空氣泡泡，僅留下質地如絲緞般的液態微奶泡。

words.definition: 天鵝與鬱金香純手工對流拉花拿鐵

examples.en: The skilled barista poured a complex winged swan pattern onto the surface of the hot vanilla latte.
examples.zh: 經驗老到的咖啡師熟練晃動鋼杯，在熱拿鐵咖啡表面拉出一隻展翅高飛的優雅天鵝拉花。

examples.en: Balancing rich espresso bitterness with sweet steamed whole milk makes the classic latte a global staple.
examples.zh: 濃縮咖啡的厚重微苦與蒸熱全脂鮮奶的天然乳糖甘甜完美交融，使經典拿鐵成為風靡全球的心靈飲品。

examples.en: Free-pour latte art competitions reward symmetry, high contrast, and difficult creative patterns.
examples.zh: 世界拿鐵拉花大賽國際裁判，依據圖案對稱性、奶白與咖啡褐的強烈對比度以及構圖難度進行評分。

words.definition: 國際 SCA 標準專業盲測杯測評鑑流程

examples.en: Coffee buyers slurp loudly from cupping spoons to spray liquid across all sensory taste receptors.
examples.zh: 尋豆師手持特製杯測匙大力吸啜，在標準杯測評鑑中讓咖啡液霧化噴灑在整個舌面感官上。

examples.en: Standardized cupping protocols mandate sniffing dry fragrance, wet aroma, and slurping at three temperatures.
examples.zh: 國際標準杯測規範嚴格要求依序評定乾香氣、濕香氣，並在滾燙、微溫與冷卻三種溫層進行啜吸評分。

examples.en: Cupping dozens of unlabeled mystery samples removes brand bias and highlights raw agricultural quality.
examples.zh: 對數十碗無標籤的匿名樣品進行盲測杯測，能徹底消除品牌既定偏見，唯讓純粹生豆品質說話。

words.definition: 明亮多汁之柑橘檸檬與蘋果果酸感

examples.en: Ethiopian washed Yirgacheffe is celebrated for its sparkling, lemon-lime citric acidity.
examples.zh: 著名的衣索比亞水洗耶加雪菲，以其如檸檬萊姆般活潑明亮、令人生津的晶瑩果酸質聞名全球。

examples.en: Pleasant malic acidity brings crisp green apple freshness that makes the mouth water.
examples.zh: 怡人多汁的天然蘋果酸質為杯中帶來如咬下青蘋果般的爽朗脆度，令人舌底生津回味無窮。

examples.en: Over-roasted dark coffees lose their sparkling acidity, leaving only dull roasty and ash-like bitterness.
examples.zh: 過度深焙的咖啡會將生豆中珍貴活潑的果酸質全數扼殺殆盡，僅留下單調死沉的煙燻焦炭苦感。

words.definition: 悠長回甘之焦糖與蔗糖天然焦香甜感

examples.en: Natural African coffees exhibit an astonishing cane sugar sweetness that lingers long on the palate.
examples.zh: 頂級日曬非洲豆展現出驚人的天然蔗糖甜感，在吞嚥後依然在口腔中回甘繚繞不絕。

examples.en: Ripe coffee cherries harvested at peak maturity provide the foundation for intense, honeyed cup sweetness.
examples.zh: 唯有在糖度巔峰期手工精選採摘的完全成熟咖啡鮮果，方能奠定杯中濃郁如蜂蜜般的天然甜感基石。

examples.en: Sweetness balances vibrant citric acidity, transforming a sour brew into a harmonious fruit nectar experience.
examples.zh: 豐沛充盈的天然果糖甜感能完美包覆活潑酸質，將原本尖銳的酸味昇華為如鮮榨果汁般的和諧享受。

words.definition: 絲滑醇厚、如奶油般之油脂醇厚度；身體

examples.en: Sumatran Mandheling delivers a rich, buttery body with earthy cocoa notes that coats the entire tongue.
examples.zh: 蘇門答臘曼特寧展現出厚實如融化奶油般的醇厚口感油脂感，深沉可可風味包覆整個舌頭。

examples.en: Light-roast Geisha lots are prized for a delicate, tea-like body rather than heavy syrupy thickness.
examples.zh: 淺度烘焙的高海拔藝伎精品豆，以其宛如大吉嶺紅茶般清透空靈的茶感質地見長，而非濃郁厚重。

examples.en: French press immersion brewing allows natural oils to pass into the cup, producing an exceptionally round body.
examples.zh: 法式濾壓壺全浸泡沖煮能讓咖啡生豆豐富的未乳化天然油脂完全保留在杯中，營造極致圓潤的醇厚口感。

words.definition: 唇齒留香、優雅悠長之花果香餘韻

examples.en: High-grown mountain coffees leave a clean aftertaste reminiscent of white peach and orange blossoms.
examples.zh: 真正頂級的高山咖啡，在喝完後會在喉頭留下如白桃與橙花般清甜優雅、持久不散的回甘餘韻。

examples.en: A harsh, drying aftertaste indicates poor roasting technique or green bean insect defects.
examples.zh: 吞嚥後喉頭若殘留刺喉、收斂乾澀的刮舌尾韻，通常代表烘焙火候失控或是生豆存在蟲蛀瑕疵。

examples.en: The sweet chocolate finish displayed an astonishing aftertaste that persisted for ten minutes.
examples.zh: 吞下這口精品濃縮咖啡後，齒頰間留存著香甜濃郁的黑巧克力尾韻，悠揚迴盪整整十分鐘之久。

words.definition: 茉莉花、佛手柑與水蜜桃杯測風味調性；注意

examples.en: The tasting card notes subtle flavor hints of dried apricot, lavender honey, and roasted almond.
examples.zh: 精品咖啡風味卡上詳盡標註著杏桃乾、薰衣草蜂蜜與烤杏仁的迷人風味調性。

examples.en: Experienced tasters distinguish subtle floral and fruit notes hidden behind initial chocolate aromas.
examples.zh: 經驗老到的感官品鑑師能輕易辨識出隱藏在第一道可可主調背後、極其幽微纖細的花香與熱帶果調。

examples.en: Each regional origin displays distinctive tasting notes influenced by processing methods and mountain elevation.
examples.zh: 每個不同國家產區的咖啡豆，在後製處理法與生長海拔的深刻烙印下，展現出截然不同的杯測風味調性。

words.definition: 融合科學與藝術的世界級專業咖啡師

examples.en: The master barista adjusts the grinder calibration three times a day to compensate for humidity shifts.
examples.zh: 追求極致的專業咖啡師，每天依據天氣濕度變化細心校正磨豆機刻度三次。

examples.en: Behind the counter, the world champion barista prepares competition routines with clinical precision.
examples.zh: 在吧台後方，奪得世界冠軍榮銜的傳奇咖啡師，以宛如外科手術般的臨床精準度演練比賽流程。

examples.en: A great barista combines thorough chemical knowledge with graceful customer service skills.
examples.zh: 一位真正頂尖優秀的吧台咖啡師，完美兼具了深厚的萃取化學理論與溫暖典雅的待客服務魅力。

words.definition: 溫暖傳遞每杯咖啡產區故事之真摯款待

examples.en: True coffee culture marries technical brewing perfection with warm, welcoming customer hospitality.
examples.zh: 真正的精品咖啡文化，將極致嚴謹的沖煮科學與熱情溫暖的職人款待之道完美融合。

examples.en: The neighborhood cafe is celebrated for its genuine hospitality, remembering regulars by their names.
examples.zh: 這家隱身巷弄的老街角咖啡館以其真誠質樸的款待熱情聞名，親切叫出每位常客的名字與喜好。

examples.en: Thoughtful hospitality turns a simple morning beverage into an uplifting personal connection.
examples.zh: 充滿溫度、體貼入微的職人真摯款待，能將一杯看似平凡的晨間咖啡昇華為撫慰人心的心靈連結。

words.definition: 對每一顆咖啡豆極致風味之無比熱情

examples.en: Spending years perfecting roasting curves is driven by an enduring passion for sensory excellence.
examples.zh: 耗費數年寒暑反覆微調烘焙曲線，背後全憑對極致風味與土地農民的一份純粹熾熱熱情。

examples.en: Her infectious passion for origin sourcing inspired customers to explore single-origin black coffees.
examples.zh: 她對親赴產地尋豆源頭所散發的感染力熱情，引領著無數原本只喝拿鐵的顧客勇敢探索單品黑咖啡。

examples.en: Every hand-poured cup reflects the roaster’s burning passion for agricultural quality and craft.
examples.zh: 吧台上親手沖煮出的每一杯香醇黑咖啡，皆深沉凝聚著烘豆職人對產地農藝品質與匠人手藝的無限熱愛。

words.definition: 清晨手沖注水靜心、喚醒靈魂之美好儀式

examples.en: The quiet morning ritual of grinding fresh beans and pouring water brings peaceful mindfulness to busy lives.
examples.zh: 清晨親手研磨新鮮咖啡豆、專注注水手沖的美好靜心儀式，為忙碌的生活注入平靜與力量。

examples.en: Preparing a deliberate pourover every Sunday afternoon has become a meditative family ritual.
examples.zh: 每逢週日下午全神貫注為家人手沖一壺花香咖啡，已成為這座家庭生活中充滿儀式感的靜心享受。

examples.en: In Japanese kissaten culture, preparing siphon coffee is treated with the solemn gravity of a tea ritual.
examples.zh: 在日本傳統喫茶店文化中，虹吸壺沖煮咖啡的每道手勢都被賦予了宛如日本茶道般莊嚴神聖的儀式感。

words.definition: 對大自然風土與農人汗水之感官鑑賞與感恩

examples.en: Tasting specialty coffee cultivates sensory appreciation for the hard work of smallholder farming families.
examples.zh: 細細品味每一口精品咖啡，能培養對大自然風土賜予與高山農人辛勤汗水的由衷鑑賞與感恩。

examples.en: Exploring origin flavor profiles deepens consumers' appreciation for terroir, elevation, and climate.
examples.zh: 深入探索各大原產地的多元風味圖譜，能極大深化都會消費者對風土、海拔與氣候條件的感官鑑賞。

examples.en: Slow sipping with deep appreciation connects city dwellers to remote volcanic mountain hillsides.
examples.zh: 靜心慢飲、心懷感恩地品嚐手中這杯黑咖啡，能跨越時空將忙碌的都會心靈與遙遠的火山咖啡莊園緊密相連。

words.definition: 啜飲第一口極致花果香咖啡的心靈愉悅至福

examples.en: Sipping a freshly brewed Geisha pourover in the morning light produces a moment of pure aromatic euphoria.
examples.zh: 在晨光中啜飲一口剛沖煮好、花香四溢的頂級藝伎咖啡，帶來靈魂深處最純粹的芳香愉悅至福。

examples.en: The breathtaking aroma of sweet bergamot and jasmine flowers washed over him in a wave of coffee euphoria.
examples.zh: 撲鼻而來的天然佛手柑與清新茉莉花芳香如潮水般席捲而來，為他帶來身心放鬆的極致咖啡愉悅感。

examples.en: Coffee enthusiasts describe their first encounter with exceptional specialty lots as pure sensory euphoria.
examples.zh: 無數狂熱精品咖啡愛好者總會動情描述，生平初次邂逅冠軍微批次名豆時那種通體舒暢的感官至福。
